string.text: the interior of laboratory X-16
the interior of laboratory X-18
Dead Telemetry
Some X-16 sensors still transmit fragmented data. Enter the laboratory and let the portable recorder synchronize with its internal network.
Enter X-16 and collect its residual telemetry.
The data packet arrived intact.
Echo of X-18
An autonomous emergency recorder remains in X-18. Enter the complex so the field unit can download its archive.
Enter X-18 and retrieve emergency telemetry.
The archive will save us from sending another expedition.
Reference Sample
Our spectrometers need a specific rare artifact for calibration. The sample will be consumed, but a protective container is included in the reward.
Deliver the requested rare artifact to the scientists.
The sample is suitable. Take the payment and container.
Dangerous Biology
A fresh organ from a rare mutant is required. Trader stock is too old for useful analysis.
Recover and deliver the requested rare mutant organ.
The specimen is viable. Take the payment and scientific medkit.
Measurement Triangle
We need synchronized background readings from three positions in the same region. Visit every marked point with the equipment active.
Visit three positions and complete the calibration series.
All three readings are synchronized.
